hints.no_clips: No clips yet — run Story→Script from the story stage first.
hints.single_clip: Only one clip: make sure opening pressure and outgoing hook both land here.
hints.missing_summary: Some clips lack a summary — add one line on what happens.
hints.missing_characters: Some clips have no characters tagged — add who appears.
hints.missing_location: Some clips have no location — optional, but helps storyboard.

opening_pressure.label: Does the opening have pressure?
opening_pressure.tip: Can the audience feel something at stake right away?

want_vs_block.label: What does the lead want — and what blocks it?
want_vs_block.tip: Desire and resistance should both be concrete

turn_choice.label: Is the turn caused by the lead's choice?
turn_choice.tip: Major turns feel stronger when the protagonist chooses, not only gets rescued

local_payoff.label: Is there a local payoff before the hook?
local_payoff.tip: Deliver something visible before withholding the next episode

next_state.label: What state enters the next episode?
next_state.tip: Name at least one: relationship, information, cost, or time

scene_change.label: Does each clip change something?
scene_change.tip: Info, relationship, ownership, risk, or irreversibility

dialogue_want.label: Is dialogue trying to get something?
dialogue_want.tip: Avoid pure exposition dumps; prefer threat, bargain, withhold, or prove

turn_setup.label: Are big turns set up?
turn_setup.tip: Coincidence should not carry the main turn alone
